craft_notes: Sthāyin: the seedless rite — the āhnika's engine (the longest unit: its length IS the ritual's procedure; owner scrutiny welcome). Sanskrit-first: sapratyayāṃ nirbījāṃ kept both adj (with-conviction + seedless); trikoṇam āgneyaṃ jvālākarālaṃ rephavisphuliṅgaṃ bahirvātyācakradhyāyamānaṃ held whole-down-the-line (five-fold mandala epithet unpacked by enjambment, row 2); phaṭkāra-successions kept the burning instrument; svakāryakaraṇasāmarthyavidhvaṃsinī unpacked as the verdict; tulayā laghuḥ dṛśyate kept the light-comparison close. Rows: 9 (fool/late-comer pair; work-capacity destroyed), 2 (long compounds spilling), 1 ('he is seen light' closes — laghu end-weight, the disciple's last state), 12 declined — procedure's roll carries, no settle. Close: 'by which, by comparison, he is seen light.' Rejected: trimming the mandala epithets — killed: each is the rite's specification; resolving 'stated initiatable' — killed: ukta-tva kept the citation-voice; 'becomes light' for laghuḥ dṛśyate — killed: seen-as-light is the comparison (dṛśyate passive). Read aloud: WITH-con-VIC-tion, SEED-less-in-i-TIA-tion — SHOWN to-the-FOOL and-to-the-LATE-COM-er … HIS-GEN-er-a-TIVE-POW-er IS-burnt … IN-stalled IN-side THE-vā-yu-PUR-a, SHAK-en, be-COME-light — BY-which, BY-com-PAR-i-son, HE-is-SEEN-light.

lines: With-conviction, seedless initiation — shown to the fool
and to the late-comer, whose power-descent has come:
a triangular āgneya mandala, flame-terrible, repha-spark,
outward-vāta-wheel-rolling, contemplated in the right hand,
a little seed cast therein — by up-down repha-revealed
Doing thus, the hand is cast onto the disciple's head:
for both, this seedless initiation destroys the capacity
for doing one's own work — since even inanimate things
are stated initiatable. The disciple is contemplated
installed inside the vāyupura, shaken, become-light —
by which, by comparison, he is seen light.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sapratyayāṃ nirbījāṃ tu yadi dīkṣāṃ mūḍhāya āyātaśaktipātāya ca darśayet tadā hi śivahastadānakāle ayaṃ vidhiḥ trikoṇam āgneyaṃ jvālākarālaṃ rephavisphuliṅgaṃ bahirvātyācakradhyāyamānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dakṣiṇahaste cintayitvā tatraiva haste bījaṃ kiṃcit nikṣipya ūrdhvādhorephavibodhitaphaṭkāraparamparābhiḥ asya tāṃ jananaśaktiṃ dahet evaṃ kurvan taṃ hastaṃ śiṣyasya mūrdhani kṣipet iti dvayor api eṣā dīkṣā nirbījā svakāryakaraṇasāmarthyavidhvaṃsinī bhavati sthāvarāṇām api dīkṣyatvena uktatvāt vāyupurāntarvyavasthitaṃ dodhūyamānaṃ śiṣyaṃ laghūbhūtaṃ cintayet yena tulayā laghuḥ dṛśyate iti

reads_against.argmap: What is the rite of the seedless initiation shown to a fool or a late-comer? → The nirbījā dīkṣā works palm-mandala → seed-burning by phaṭkāras → hand-on-head, destroying svakārya-karaṇa-sāmarthya; even sthāvara qualify, and the light-comparison confirms the disciple's laghūbhāva.
c1_essence: The seedless initiation to fool or late-comer: āgneya palm-mandala, seed burnt by phaṭkāra-successions, hand cast on the head — own-work-capacity destroyed, even inanimate initiatable; the disciple contemplated shaken and light within the vāyupura.
